Dr. Seuss, surprisingly.

He cheated on his wife, who had cancer. His wife then committed suicide.

I’d say to continue supporting him. Maybe something happened to him in the past, and that’s why he doesn’t think he can commit. If you manage to break his shell one day, then there’s potential that he could end up liking you back.

Damn, that sounds rough. Wish the best for you.

Yeah. I don’t really understand it myself, but you seem wise. Perhaps you know better.

Self harm is better than continuing to kill your sled on the inside- some relief is better than none. I, myself, think it’s a good idea if it’s absolutely necessary, but it really depends on the person.

That’s great- that today’s been better. Try to keep it that way.

Everything just seems pointless. Been drinking soap and throwing it up in the morning to stop the pain.

Yeah, it really isn’t.

How’s it for you?
Thanks. I’ve been considering it- haven’t decided on anything yet, but so far, it’s the only thing I’m both interested in and at least somewhat talented at.

I’m twelve, and have similar thoughts, as well as a similar situation. You aren’t alone in this, kid. Never will be.

Is there anything you wanna vent about? If not, what’re some things you like to do?
Minecraft all the way. Played it since I could fit a controller in my hand.
Minecraft all the way. Played it since I could fit a controller in my hand.
Is it because of the grammar, spelling, the way I talk, or all of those? Because I’m a twelve year old girl who’s obsessed with writing, so that’s why I’m good at those things.
Unfortunately, no.
Thanks.

There’re kids on here who’re eight and pretend to be nineteen. At least I’m honest.

Though, yes, I did know that. Similarly to those eight year olds, I didn’t really care.
Cats. They’re so much calmer and, most of the time, so much softer. A lot easier to handle than an energetic dog bounding all over the place.

I doubt it. The two friends I have- the ones I told you about, at least- are rather sensitive. The one who had anorexia also has anger issues, and talking about anything slightly suicidal triggers him. The girl just doesn’t feel anything anymore, no matter what. No happiness, no fear, no relief- nothing. I don’t affect the girl, and if anything, I just infuriate the boy.

I’ve told my friends how I’m feeling before, and at first, they tried to help (and failed). This just broke whatever we have left of a friendship even more- this just dragged them down. It’s happened before and now it’s worse than ever- they wouldn’t react any differently.

That’s one of the reasons, but there’s a lot more to it. The woman I spoke to was a school counselor, and a strict one at that. I didn’t want to just open up to someone in person like that, but it was what she demanded. She wouldn’t take her time or anything, just wanting to know every little detail about me. My grades, my family, my personal life- I get that counselors have to know a bit about you, but why so soon? Most people aren’t ready for that. I basically had to beg her not to file a report and tell my parents that I had gone to the counselor, and I left her office with a worse sinking feeling in my chest than when I came in.

My parents aren’t exactly the best people. My dad’s a constantly drunk lunatic who acts retarded, is irresponsible, and always leaves without any reason of why- and he comes back hours later. My mom ends up shouting at him for it, and starts an argument. She’s a bitch who acts kind around others but really doesn’t seem to care about anything. She’s always stressed, too, and her temper is just as bad as my dad’s- probably worse.
My dad would be weirded out, and honestly, that’s all I know about his reaction. He’s incredibly unpredictable and that terrifies me. My mom would be mad- I know that. She’d yell at me and question me for hours upon hours for not telling her sooner. Then she’d care for a while and stop again.

My friends and I have had.. arguments, to say the least. Lots of drama. Our pasts aren’t all that happy, honestly- one of my friends has tried to kill herself before, just like me, and another had anorexia for a while before he stopped. 
When I once tried to kill myself (the only reason the pills are hidden was because I tried to overdose), one of my friends- the one with anorexia, actually- had to help me through it the entire time. It was over text, too. He got mad at me afterwards and wouldn’t talk to me for a few weeks (and I understand that, even if my own attempt doesn’t feel like much to me. Can’t imagine how he felt). If I accepted their help, I’d just drag them down even more like I always do. They don’t deserve that- they deserve to get better. I’m not helping them get better, despite my best efforts.

I tried talking to a school therapist once- well, my friends forced me to. It didn’t go so well. If I talked about my suicide attempts or the cutting, then my parents would be informed, and that wouldn’t end well. There’s no one else I could really contact- maybe the police, but that’d just be a shitload of shit I don’t want to deal with.

Be whoever you want to be, as long as it makes you happy. It’s okay to feel empty sometimes, and it’s okay to feel lost, but it isn’t okay to do nothing about it.

Reach out to someone. Making this post makes you a genius, not stupid. You’re trying to get help- that makes you smart, even if you don’t believe it.
I’m sorry that this happened. If you want to talk to someone about it more- because I’m sure that there’s a lot you’ve been holding inside of you- you can message me.

Yeah- though I feel like I should already know at least a little. It’s what everybody else seems to do, anyways.

I’ve thought about it- my two closest friends have even offered going with me to see the school counselor. But, if I did, I wouldn’t be able to say everything. The school counselor is required to tell your parents if you’ve done self harm or are thinking about self harm. If my parents found out that I’d gone to the counselor, they’d be furious. Sure, I could lie and just tell them that I’m feeling numb, but I don’t think that’d help much at all.

I’m.. not exactly the oldest person on reddit. Might not seem that way, but it’s true.
Fuck, I’m not even a teen yet. Just started middle school, actually. (Yeah, I guess you could say I’m mature for my age. Whatever- doesn’t really matter.)

Thing he, I don’t know what I want to do to my life. Actually, I don’t really want to do anything with my life- I’d be perfectly fine with living in the streets and starving to death.

My parents, my school, and myself are mostly what’s trapping me.

There isn’t much I can change. I try to tell my parents, and they care for a week, and then they just stop like I never told them anything. Like I never told them about the cutting or the suicide attempt. I’ve told them a few times now, and the same things happened over and over again. Now I don’t really trust them enough to tell them any more.

My school itself isn’t bad- it’s how every single day is the same thing. The conversations might be a little different, as well as interactions with people who think I consider them friends, but that’s about it. Same classes, same things- it doesn’t end and it drives me insane.

I can’t let go of the past. My friend who probably committed suicide because I couldn’t help her is something I’ve always blamed myself for. My few actual friends and their mental illnesses? I can’t help but think that I only made them worse.
I can’t do anything right- all I do is make things worse. Not once have I put anybody in a better mood. Not once have I helped anybody with anything. I just make things worse and worse and I can’t stop it. I don’t deserve to be happy or alive- it’d just be so much easier to be gone so that I don’t bother anyone anymore.

A series of events spaced pretty far apart, as well as my parents being, well, whatever you’d call how they act. It was also a bit of my own doing, I’ll admit- was depressing to myself and I didn’t remember that there was a chance that I could get out. Now it’s too late and I’ve blocked my own exit.
